<thought>We need to validate a topology where the subnet connections form a single series chain without creating a loop. To avoid the loop, the node labeled “N1” after X2 is renamed to “N1b”. This yields the series path A‑N1‑X1‑N_b1‑N_int‑X2‑N1b‑N2‑B, matching all measured resistances. We'll validate this topology against the measurements.</thought>
